value.rationale: Two localized exchange-sign defects are a motivated Ising impurity placement problem. Exact all-size strict placement extremizers and a \(O(n)\) temperature-rescaled fluctuation peak with a proven globally optimized asymptotic coefficient discriminate engineered two-domain rings from homogeneous AF rings; not just a transfer-matrix restatement, and neither finite enumeration nor approximate numerical maximum alone carries the claim.
